summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a small property acquisition on July 15, 2026, under the previously disclosed Asset Purchase Agreement with Arcade Technology LLC and Purchase and Sale Agreement with Arcade Realty LLC. The company acquired parcels of real property at 38 Union Avenue, Bridgeport, Connecticut for $2,300,000. This is a routine real estate purchase for corporate use (a building), not an M&A special situation: no target company acquisition, no material business combination, no unusual structural features. The filing also notes a corporate address change. Filed as an emerging growth company under the Exchange Act.
